data.name: Mist Trail: Vernal and Nevada Falls
data.description: A private, guided hike on Yosemite’s Mist Trail. Visit thundering Vernal and Nevada Falls, possibly getting soaked by the spray! At the top of Nevada Fall, peek down over the edge. Then, descend on the John Muir Trail, with panoramic views of Half Dome.

meeting_point.address: Curry Village Shuttle Stop 14, Yosemite, CA US
